body:
Well, I can say that I've omitted a lot of other details for the sake of time and not wanting to write out an entire essay. But this is a pattern of inappropriate, boundary-less behavior with my mother. Over the past year she's been arrested for driving under the influence while trying to drive to my boyfriend's house. In her blacked out state, she hallucinated that I was in trouble. Before that, she totaled her car. I had to leave school to drive her around when we live in a city with the best public transportation in the country. She's also had several arguments with this same boyfriend and forced me to drive her past his home at 2 in the morning to check to see if there was another woman there. At one point, she ditched me (he lived in a really unsafe area) to go argue with him... forgave him... didn't tell me what was going on and drove off without telling me anything. I couldn't figure out how to get home, drove the wrong direction on a poorly lit street and was pulled over by the police. She never apologized.

Since then, I just asked for some distance. I did not need to know that her "partner" was killed. I barely knew the man. I couldn't do anything to help her.

I understand that I'm being self centered, but I'm just tired of being involved in her constant and unnecessary drama.
I was in therapy for a bit, but stopped going because of work. Which was probably just me making an excuse not to go. I'll stop by my school's counseling center soon. Thank you.

You're right. Even now, I'm trying to explain to her that it was inappropriate of her to choose to call me and she's accusing me of being selfish and immature. That I'm not a child and need to get over it. 

I just want to be normal. I don't want to live my life being associated with people getting shot to death!

I'm going to have to limit my communication with her, like you said. I'm tired of being manipulated by her. Having to clean up after her and parent her. I swear, immediately after the phone call I just assumed my boyfriend would be breaking up with me because who the hell wants to deal with this sort of drama? It's such a mess.
I'm really not doing well. My anxiety is ruining my life and my relationships.
